title: Grade 6 French — Mon, Jun 09
description: Les sports et les loisirs — Day 1 of 5: Jouer à vs faire de
subject: french

questions.question: Which verb is used for sports played with a ball or team?
questions.explanation: 'Jouer à' is used for team sports and games (football, tennis, chess). 'Je joue au football.' = I play football.

questions.question: Which verb is used for individual sports and activities?
questions.explanation: 'Faire de' is used for individual sports and activities. 'Je fais du vélo.' = I cycle.

questions.question: How do you say 'I play football' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Je joue au football.' = I play football. 'Jouer à' + 'le' = 'jouer au'.

questions.question: How do you say 'I cycle' (I do cycling) in French?
questions.explanation: 'Je fais du vélo.' = I cycle. 'Faire de' + 'le' = 'faire du'.

questions.question: Complete: 'Je ___ tennis.' (I play tennis.)
questions.explanation: 'Je joue au tennis.' = I play tennis. Tennis is a sport played with a racket/opponent → 'jouer à'.

questions.question: Complete: 'Il ___ natation.' (He does swimming.)
questions.explanation: 'Il fait de la natation.' = He does swimming. 'Natation' is feminine → 'de la'.

questions.question: How do you say 'She plays chess' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Elle joue aux échecs.' = She plays chess. 'Jouer à' + 'les' = 'jouer aux' (plural noun).

questions.question: What is 'loisirs' in English?
questions.explanation: 'Les loisirs' = leisure activities / hobbies. 'Mes loisirs sont la lecture et la natation.' = My hobbies are reading and swimming.

questions.question: Which sport uses 'jouer à'?
questions.explanation: 'Jouer au basket-ball.' — basketball is a team sport. Swimming, skiing, dancing use 'faire de'.

questions.question: Which activity uses 'faire de'?
questions.explanation: 'Faire de la guitare.' = to play guitar (as an activity). Musical instruments and individual activities use 'faire de'.

questions.question: Complete: 'Nous ___ rugby le week-end.'
questions.explanation: 'Nous jouons au rugby le week-end.' = We play rugby at the weekend. Rugby is a team sport → 'jouer à'.

questions.question: How do you say 'They do gymnastics'?
questions.explanation: 'Ils font de la gymnastique.' = They do gymnastics. Individual activity → 'faire de'.

questions.question: What is the rule for choosing 'jouer à' vs 'faire de'?
options: 'Faire de' for individual/solo activities; 'jouer à' for team games and sports with opponents
'Faire de' for indoor sports; 'jouer à' for outdoor
There is no rule — both mean the same
questions.explanation: 'Faire de' = individual/solo (natation, ski, danse, vélo); 'Jouer à' = team sports and games with an opponent (football, tennis, échecs).

questions.question: Choose the correct form: 'Je ___ foot avec mes amis.'
questions.explanation: 'Je joue au foot avec mes amis.' = I play football with my friends. 'Jouer à' + 'le' → 'jouer au'.

questions.question: Complete: 'Ma sœur ___ piano et mon frère ___ football.'
questions.explanation: 'Ma sœur joue du piano et mon frère joue au football.' = My sister plays piano and my brother plays football. Piano = instrument → 'jouer de'; Football = team → 'jouer à'.
